day_local: Il-Ħamsa u Għoxrin Ħadd fiż-Żmien ta’ Matul is-Sena
greeting: F’isem il-Missier, u l-Iben, u l-Ispirtu Imqaddes. Il-Mulej ik kans u jżommkom fil-paċi tiegħu f’dan il-jum li fih niġbru qlubna quddiemu.
penitential:
Mulej, ħenn għal nina, għax diftarna dnibna lejk.
Kristu, int li ftaħt il-qalb tal-Missier għalina, ħenn għal nina.
Mulej, agħtina l-paċi li l-art ma tistax tagħti.
psalm_response: Il-Mulej qrib ta’ dawk kollha li jsejħulu.
homily:
Hemm imwiet fil-ħajja li jixbhu lil dawk ix-xemgħat li jintfew f’daqqa f’kamra miftuħa għar-riħ ta’ barra, u f’daqqa waħda dak li kien imdawwal isir kollu skiet u dell. Imma hemm ukoll il-mod kif il-Mulej iħares lejn l-istorja tagħna, mod li hu daqshekk differenti mill-kejl tagħna… bħal dak is-sid tal-vinja fl-Evanġelju li joħroġ filgħodu, f’nofsinhar, u anke fil-ħamsa ta’ wara nofsinhar, biex isejjach lin-nies f’kull siegħa, jagħtihom l-istess paga, l-istess qalb, l-istess dar. 

Meta nħarsu lejn il-qari tal-lum f’dan l-istaġun tal-ħajja, meta diġà għaddew tliet xhur minn dakinhar li Benjamin Vo tela’ lejn il-Banquet tas-Sema fit-13 ta’ Ġunju 2026, il-kliem tal-profeta Isaija jidħol dritt fil-fond tal-ferita tagħna: ‘Għax il-ħsibijiet tiegħi mhumiex il-ħsibijiet tagħkom, u lanqas it-triqat tagħkom mhumiex it-triqat tiegħej, jgħid il-Mulej.’ 

Alan u Thao, intom li qed iġġorru dan l-uġigħ tqil wisq f’qalbkom, u Ryan, int li qed tiftakar lil ħuk il-ħin kollu f’kull pass li tagħmel, tafu kemm hi diffiċli li taċċetta dan il-kejl divin meta l-kejl uman tagħ Jidher li qed jitlob spjegazzjonijiet. F’dawk il-mumenti meta l-moħħ imur lura għal dawk il-jiem ta’ qabel, meta kont tisma’ lil Ben jitkellem b’dak it-tbissima ħelwa u l-gigs tiegħu fuq l-ajruplani u l-ħolma tiegħu ta’ 'con chim airlines', id-dar tidher vojta wisq. Il-moħħ jibda jistaqsi, ifittex fejn seta’ kien hemm żball, jekk setax sar xi ħaġa aħjar. Ħalluni ngħidilkom illum, b’vuċi mimlija ħniena f’isem il-Mulej: Il-marda li ħadet lil Ben ma kienet tort ta’ ħadd. Qatt ma kienet kastig, u qatt ma kienet nuqqas min-naħa tagħkom. Hemm affarijiet f’din id-dinja li huma lil hinn minn kull kontroll uman, lil hinn minn kull ħarsa u minn kull kura. Alla ma jakkużakom b’xejn; Hu jara d-dmugħ tagħkom u jrid ineħħi dak il-blat tqil minn fuq sidirkom. Intom maħbubin.

U f’nofs dan kollu, tqum dik ix-xbieha tal-ġenerożità ta’ Ben. Aħna niftakru f’dak it-tifel li, b’dik il-qalb safja li kienet tiddistingwih, darba qal lil ommu u lil missieru li kien lest jagħti l-piggy bank kollu tiegħu biex jgħin lil ziju William f’mument ta’ bżonn kbir. Ma kienx hemm bżonn li jikser il-piggy bank; l-offerta kienet diġà sħiħa quddiem Alla, għax qalb Ben kienet diġà tgħallem tħobb mingħajr ma żżomm xejn lura. Dik l-imħabba ma tmutx. Hija qed tkompli tgħix f’dak il-bir ta’ ilma ħaj li nfetħet f’Cà Mau f’ismu, biex tagħti x-xorb lil dawk li huma bil-għatx, eżattament kif Ben kien iħobb jagħti lil kulħadd.

Aħna m’aħniex waħedna. San Pawl fl-ittra tiegħu lill-Filippin jgħidilna: ‘Għalija l-ħajja hija Kristu, u l-mewt qligħ.’ Ben għamel dak il-qabża lejn il-qligħ kbir tal-eternità, u issa jinsab fejn m’hemmx aktar dmugħ. Ryan, int trid tkompli toħlom, tkompli tħares lejn is-sema u l-ajruplani, u tiftakar li ħuk jinsab hemm fuq, jistenna bi tbissima. Ejjew inħallu l-paċi tal-Mulej tidħol fil-qalb ta’ kull wieħed minna täna. Il-Mulej jagħtik, Benjamin, il-mistrieħ ta’ dejjem. Amen.
standing_petitions: Għal Benjamin u l-mejtin kollha, li jistrieħu fid-dawl u l-paċi ta’ Kristu, nitolbu lill-Mulej.
Għal dawk kollha li qed jibku t-telfa ta’ maħbub, li Alla jfarraġhom u jimla qalbhom bit-tama, nitolbu lill-Mulej.
spiritual_communion: Ġesù tiegħi, nemmen li int tinsab tabilħaqq fis-Sagrament tal-Altar. Inħobbok fuq kollox u nixtieq nirċieviġ f’ruħi. Peress li issa ma nistgħux nieħduk fis-Sagrament, ejja għall-inqas spiritwalment f’qalbi. Ngħannaq miegħek bħallikieku diġà qiegħed hawn, u nitlobek li qatt ma tħallini nifuġ minnek.
closing: Il-Mulej beriek u ħares u jżomm il-paċi tiegħu magħkom illum u għal dejjem. Amen.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text:
Seek the LORD while he may be found,
call him while he is near.
Let the scoundrel forsake his way,
and the wicked his thoughts;
let him turn to the LORD for mercy;
to our God, who is generous in forgiving.
For my thoughts are not your thoughts,
nor are your ways my ways, says the LORD.
As high as the heavens are above the earth,
so high are my ways above your ways
and my thoughts above your thoughts.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text:
R. (18a) The Lord is near to all who call upon him.
Every day will I bless you,
and I will praise your name forever and ever.
Great is the LORD and highly to be praised;
his greatness is unsearchable.
R. The Lord is near to all who call upon him.
The LORD is gracious and merciful,
slow to anger and of great kindness.
The LORD is good to all
and compassionate toward all his works.
R. The Lord is near to all who call upon him.
The LORD is just in all his ways
and holy in all his works.
The LORD is near to all who call upon him,
to all who call upon him in truth.
R. The Lord is near to all who call upon him.

readings.label: Reading 2
readings.text:
Brothers and sisters:
Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death. 
For to me life is Christ, and death is gain. 
If I go on living in the flesh,
that means fruitful labor for me. 
And I do not know which I shall choose. 
I am caught between the two. 
I long to depart this life and be with Christ,
for that is far better. 
Yet that I remain in the flesh
is more necessary for your benefit.

Only, conduct yourselves in a way worthy of the gospel of Christ.

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text:
Jesus told his disciples this parable:
"The kingdom of heaven is like a landowner
who went out at dawn to hire laborers for his vineyard. 
After agreeing with them for the usual daily wage,
he sent them into his vineyard. 
Going out about nine o'clock,
the landowner saw others standing idle in the marketplace,
and he said to them, 'You too go into my vineyard,
and I will give you what is just.'
So they went off. 
And he went out again around noon,
and around three o'clock, and did likewise. 
Going out about five o'clock,
the landowner found others standing around, and said to them,
'Why do you stand here idle all day?'
They answered, 'Because no one has hired us.'
He said to them, 'You too go into my vineyard.'
When it was evening the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman,
'Summon the laborers and give them their pay,
beginning with the last and ending with the first.'
When those who had started about five o'clock came,
each received the usual daily wage. 
So when the first came, they thought that they would receive more,
but each of them also got the usual wage. 
And on receiving it they grumbled against the landowner, saying,
'These last ones worked only one hour,
and you have made them equal to us,
who bore the day's burden and the heat.'
He said to one of them in reply,
'My friend, I am not cheating you. 
Did you not agree with me for the usual daily wage? 
Take what is yours and go. 
What if I wish to give this last one the same as you? 
Or am I not free to do as I wish with my own money? 
Are you envious because I am generous?'
Thus, the last will be first, and the first will be last."

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
